description: This PHP class represents a Doctrine ORM entity for the 'ohrm_module_default_page' table, defining the structure and relations of module default pages within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ModuleDefaultPage
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the ohrm_module_default_page database table, with properties for id, action, enableClass, priority, and relationships to UserRole and Module entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the module default page.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the module default page.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the module default page.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action associated with the module default page.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Returns the enable class name for the default page.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the enable class name for the default page.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the default page.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the default page.
